mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% reduces discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining more than 0.5% over 3 months indicates manufacturing supply chain disruption that compresses corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Stable low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.5% annualized) reduces central bank tightening risk and maintains favorable real rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,200,000 units annually signals strong consumer confidence and construction activity that boosts corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust labor market and consumer spending that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS increase, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth exceeding 2.5% year-over-year indicates strong economic expansion that accelerates corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
